snippet.title: BLOW-UP: AVENGE HUMANITY Demo Gameplay
snippet.description:
BLOW-UP: AVENGE HUMANITY is a pulse-pounding single-player FPS where you control a repurposed industrial robot on a mission to annihilate the alien invaders responsible for Earth's downfall. Experience high-octane combat and become humanity's last hope for vengeance.

#BlowUp #FPS #IndieGame

Play the demo at https://playtester.io
